title: Sonam Wangchuk news LIVE: Activist's weight, BP drops; Dipke issues ‘empty utensils’ appeal amid mass hunger strike
description: Sonam Wangchuk news LIVE: As Sonam Wangchuk's weight and blood pressure drop and his hunger strike continues, Abhijit Dipke has appealed to supporters to join the move and post pictures of “empty utensils” online. Meanwhile, the Delhi High Court directed the government to monitor Wangchuk's health.
